xdg_config_home.description: User-specific XDG config directory for autostart entries

xdg_config_dirs.description: System-wide XDG config directories (colon-separated in rendered output)

fbxdg_de.description: Development environment identifier (case-sensitive); must match desktop environment in .desktop files

home.description: User's home directory (used for ~ expansion in paths)

username.description: Username used to derive HOME if not explicitly set
